specs.label: MacBook Air and the Environment
specs.value: MacBook Air is designed to reduce environmental impact:9 See the MacBook Air Product Environmental Report (PDF)- opens in new tab Progress towards Apple 2030 Apple 2030 is our commitment to be carbon neutral for our entire carbon footprint. Our plan to decarbonise products is rigorous and focuses on transitioning to low‑carbon electricity, designing with recycled and low‑carbon materials and prioritising lower‑carbon ways of shipping products, like sea freight. See Apple’s commitment Materials MacBook Air is made with 55% recycled content,10 including: 100% recycled aluminium in the enclosure and trackpad gel plate 100% recycled cobalt and 95% recycled lithium in the battery 100% recycled gold plating in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards and all connectors 100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets 100% recycled tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards 90% recycled steel in the keyboard feature plate and trackpad beam Energy 50% of manufacturing electricity for MacBook Air is sourced from low-carbon electricity11 ENERGY STAR® certified12 Packaging 100% fibre-based packaging13 Waste No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Programme14 Smarter chemistry15 All of the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification(PDF) opens in new tab, which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest En­viron­men­tal Progress Report(PDF) opens in new tab to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
